leadText: Yoshihiro (Japanese: ヨシヒロ Yoshihiro) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.
plainText:
Yoshihiro (Japanese: ヨシヒロ Yoshihiro) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.

==In the games==
 ]]
 

===Warlord information===
====Rank I====
 

====Rank II====
 

Transforms to Rank II by reaching a 60% link with Gurdurr or Conkeldurr. (Cannot transform during )

===Default Pokémon===
 
 
===Links===
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
====Unobtainable links====
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

===Quotes===
Start of turn:
When asleep:
"Still asleep, eh?"
With low health or a status ailment:
"The real battle begins now..."
When victory is near:
"Victory is within our grasp!"
Otherwise:
"Let's do this."

Start of battle:
When attacking a castle: 
"Let's have a little fun."
When defending a castle: 
"We must be thankful for this chance."

During battle: 
"The good thing about battle is that you never know what will happen! We must simply fight the best way we know and see what happens!"

When ordering to attack: 
" ! ! Now!"

When ordering to go to battle: 
To a kingdom:
"Victory, or defeat... Which will it be? Let us take a gamble."
To a wild Pokémon location:
"Time for a bit of fun, I think."

Upon forming a link: 
"You're with me, !"

When using an item: 
"Maybe I'll try my !"

When using his Warrior Skill: 
"Let's take a gamble..."

After winning a battle: 
If he attacked a castle:
"Never have I enjoyed myself so greatly!"
If he defended a castle:
"Victory again! I'm just too good to ever give this up!"

When defeated:
If recruitable:
"Well... You're impressive, no doubt about it."
If defeated by something other than the enemy:
"The unexpected! That's what makes the battlefield so exciting..."
Otherwise:
"They're good. We must retreat."

When being recruited:
"Yes, I daresay we could have some fun in battle together."

When there are 50 Warriors in the army:
"Ho! We've got to 50 allies! The Pokémon are rejoicing!"

===Profile===
A heroic and large-hearted type who loves nothing more than a good battle, particularly one where the chances of winning appear to be slim.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~===
Yoshihiro debuted in PNA2.
